ety.text: Literally, “to go to Tula with your own samovar”; compare bring owls to Athens and carry coals to Newcastle. The phrase derives from the fact that Tula is well known for its samovars. The phrase was coined by Chekhov.

s.g: litany, suffrage (one of a number of prayer petitions that make up most of the worship in the Orthodox Church)
